headlines.title: AEP Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Earnings, Expands Capital Plan and Increases Growth Outlook
headlines.summary: American Electric Power (Nasdaq: AEP) today reported third-quarter 2026 GAAP earnings of $1,187 million or $2.18 per share, compared with GAAP earnings of $972 million or $1.82 per share in third-quarter 2025. Operating earnings for third-quarter 2026 were $1,216 million or $2.23 per share, compared with operating earnings of $963 million or $1.80 per share in third-quarter 2025. See the detailed GAAP-to-operating earnings reconciliation at the end of this news release.

headlines.title: What Does American Electric Power Company (AEP) Gain From Its 960 MW Nuclear Plan?
headlines.summary: American Electric Power Company (NasdaqGS:AEP) agreed a joint development deal with X-energy and Amazon for a 960-megawatt advanced nuclear project in Indiana. The proposed facility would repurpose a former coal plant site and use X-energy small modular reactor technology to supply carbon-free power. Amazon plans to support the project through funding and a long-term power purchase arrangement, anchoring demand for the prospective output.

description: American Electric Power Company, Inc., an electric public utility holding company, engages in the generation, transmission, and distribution of electricity for sale to retail and wholesale customers in the United States. It operates through Vertically Integrated Utilities, Transmission and Distribution Utilities, AEP Transmission Holdco, and Generation & Marketing segments. The company generates electricity using coal and lignite, nuclear, natural gas, renewable, hydro, solar, wind, and other energy sources; owns, operates, maintains, and invests in transmission infrastructure; and engages in the retail supply, and wholesale energy trading and marketing businesses. It operates approximately 252,000 circuit miles of distribution lines; 38,000 circuit miles of transmission lines; and 25,000 MWs of regulated owned generating capacity. American Electric Power Company, Inc. was incorporated in 1906 and is headquartered in Columbus, Ohio.
